description: Create a new example application that demonstrates 3D visualization techniques in the terminal using Braille canvas rendering. The example should visualize a financial volatility surface with interactive rotation and zoom controls, showcasing perspective projection and smooth animations. This will serve as an educational resource for developers interested in advanced terminal graphics.
functional_requirements: Implement a 3D volatility surface visualization using Canvas widget with Braille markers for high-resolution rendering
Add interactive controls allowing users to rotate the 3D surface horizontally/vertically and zoom in/out using keyboard inputs
Include synthetic data generation for the volatility surface to make the example self-contained without external dependencies
Implement perspective projection calculations to convert 3D coordinates to 2D terminal space
Create smooth animation patterns for the visualization with proper state management
Provide a complete runnable example with documentation showing how to build and interact with the visualization
